scope: Missing visible midnight Materials maps, including Instance items; Composed materials excluded

pigment-families.supports: Argentleaf, Mana Lily, Sanguithorn and Tranquility Bloom each yield the matching pigment; Azeroot is not a pigment input.

milling.supports: Ten matching Midnight herbs consumed by Inscription.

prospecting.supports: Five matching ores consumed; random outputs.
prospecting.review: readable search-index spell and independently retrieved live public spell tooltip

gem-families.supports: Ore-specific raw gem families and Eversong Diamond specialty/bonus path.

crushing.supports: Crush three Midnight gems plus one Dusk-Shrouded Stone. Gemdust is not a direct ore/prospecting drop.

recycling.review: readable indexed localized spell text and English player comments

recycling-inputs.supports: Powder Pigment yields Evercore; Soul Sprocket yields Aetherlume. Sprocket uses ore plus purchased Malleable Wireframe.
recycling-inputs.review: readable guide excerpt; recipe costs also retained in the existing verified craft catalog

fishing-overview.supports: Midnight fishing source family, lures and treasure-pool context.

coiled-pools.supports: Fourteen named fish pool targets, reported Spotted Killifish open-water pin, special lure and Blightswarmer progression; these are reports, not guaranteed requirements/yields.

venom-fishing.supports: Venom-water fishing is a separate progression ability; no hard skill threshold inferred.
venom-fishing.review: readable indexed PTR spell description; used as contextual guidance only

snakehead.supports: Bubbling Beryl catches without lure, plus reported lure-enabled open-water alternative.
snakehead.review: readable indexed item reports across PTR versions

stargorger.supports: Convert eligible Coiled Isle pools to Torrential Gorgerswarm; recipe reputation and /way #2512 51.6 49.8 Sluggs access.
stargorger.review: readable indexed item/spell player reports and tooltip

rock.supports: 238490 precursor transforms into inspectable 266102; reported wait and random inspection results.
rock.review: readable opened live item page and linked precursor identity

novelty-rock.supports: Documented Midnight fishing regions; novelty item rather than Cosmetic.

novelty-treasure.supports: Fishing source zones and novelty use; no guaranteed catches.

worm.supports: Fishing regions include Eversong, Zul-Aman, Harandar, Coiled Isle; Unique 20 fishing lure.

snail.supports: Fishing regions include Eversong, Zul-Aman, Harandar, Coiled Isle; Unique 20 fishing lure.

line-fragments.supports: Lower-tier fishing fragments can be fished in Midnight regions; combining them is separate processing, no historical ratios imported.

filleting.supports: CURRENT live spell consumes one fish, correcting stale five-fish descriptions.
filleting.review: fresh public Retail spell tooltip dataEnv=1, locale=0; indexed spell agrees

recipe-bottle.supports: Bound bottle from eligible treasure pools; individual recipe outputs, older-zone pool reports and duplicate/eligibility caveats.

heliotrope.supports: PvP reward containers and Mirvedon Honor alternative.

pvp-hub.supports: Silvermoon quartermaster context only; no unsupported pin or fixed price.

legacy-heraldry.supports: Season 1 earning sources have ended; retained item gets explicitly historical map context.

modified-nodes.supports: Coiled Isle Curse Surge window; Venomous cleansing and pickup for Clot versus Cursed gathering/Overload for Globe.

gathering-context.supports: Cursed Land and Waters and other gathering-profession contexts.

reviewLimits: Public Retail tooltip identities were refreshed for every missing item; two live spell tooltips resolve processing quantity.
Acquisition evidence reviewed by source family; inherited route geometry and its older URLs were not independently re-surveyed.
Rotating fishing pools and node modifiers use source-area navigation, not fabricated pins.
Legacy Galactic Combatant Heraldry map is historical source context; not a current farm.
No composed graphs, item categories or existing working maps were changed.
Native WoW rendering, spawns, loot eligibility and yields remain untested.
